question.problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 7 & 4 \\ 3 & 6 & 3\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

By applying elementary column operations of the form ${C}_{i}:={C}_{i}+k{C}_{1},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the elementary column operations?
question.worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries to the right of ${a}_{31}=3$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary column operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 7 & 4 \\ 3 & 6 & 3\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-2{C}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{3}:={C}_{3}-{C}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =B\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the elementary column operations are

$\,$ ${C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-2{C}_{1}\,$ and $\,{C}_{3}:={C}_{3}-{C}_{1}.$
